def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    r=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) for x in row if x==3)
    c=next(j for row in grid for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==3)
    dirs=[(-1,0),(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1)]
    step=2; d=0
    while 0<=r<len(grid) and 0<=c<len(grid[0]):
        dr,dc=dirs[d%4]
        for _ in range(step):
            r+=dr;c+=dc
            if not (0<=r<len(grid) and 0<=c<len(grid[0])): return out
            if grid[r][c]==2: return out
            out[r][c]=3
        d+=1
        if d%2==0: step+=2
    return out
